```ts
const resp = await client.invoke('summarize', {text});
const out = resp.outputs?.[0]?.text ?? (client.config.compatibility ? resp.function_call?.args?.text : null);
```
I'll add a safe helper `safeFirstOutputText()` instead of nested access.
